clips.title: The story
paras: In northeastern Tirisfal Glades, Scarlet Watch Post guards the rocky hills just north of the Scarlet Monastery. Its garrison watches the monastery’s northern flank for attacks.

Scarlet Watch Post watches the northern cliffs behind the Scarlet Monastery. The southern road to the monastery gate is busy and fortified, but the rugged cliffs along Tirisfal’s northern coast offer infiltrators a back route. The Scarlet Crusade built this stone tower to guard that blind spot. It is one of several Crusader outposts scattered across Tirisfal Glades. Captain Melrache commands a mixed, devout force of Neophytes, Vanguards, and Friars. They keep watch over the cliffs so neither the Scourge nor the Forsaken can surprise the order from behind.
